title: Hochschild Cocycle and Universality of Merge
abstract: arXiv:2611.20305v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Hopf algebra Markov chain dynamical system, on the Hopf algebra of non-planar binary forests, that models the action of Merge on workspaces in Chomsky's Minimalist Model of syntax, satisfies a universal property, determined by the fact that the Merge operation is a Hochschild 1-cocycle. This universal property has an interpretation in terms of models of the syntax-semantics interface, as it shows that, if the side of semantics possesses a sufficiently rich compositional structure, then that structure is uniquely induced by the syntactic Merge, once the semantic values of lexical items and syntactic features are assigned. We illustrate how this universality works by showing, in particular, full compatibility of this Hopf algebraic formulation with Heim-Kratzer semantics.

translated_title: Hochschild上循环与合并操作的普适性
translated_abstract: 在非平面二元森林的Hopf代数上构建的Hopf代数马尔可夫链动力系统，模拟了乔姆斯基句法极简模型中合并操作对工作区的作用，该系统满足一个普适性质，而这一性质由合并操作是一个Hochschild 1-上循环这一事实所决定。该普适性在句法-语义界面模型方面有一种解释：它表明，如果语义一方具有足够丰富的组合结构，那么一旦词项和句法特征的语义值被指定，该结构就由句法合并唯一地诱导出来。我们通过特别展示这种Hopf代数表述与Heim-Kratzer语义学的完全兼容性，阐明了这种普适性是如何运作的。
tldr: 论文证明了模拟乔姆斯基极简句法模型中合并操作的Hopf代数马尔可夫链系统满足由合并是Hochschild 1-上循环所决定的普适性质，表明语义的组合结构由句法合并唯一诱导，并与Heim-Kratzer语义学完全兼容。
en_tdlr: The paper proves that the Hopf algebraic Markov chain system modeling Merge in Chomsky's Minimalist syntax satisfies a universal property determined by Merge being a Hochschild 1-cocycle, showing that the compositional structure of semantics is uniquely induced by syntactic Merge and is fully compatible with Heim-Kratzer semantics.
